title: anim.wave.live/1
description: data/anim/waves/<wave>.live.json: go-live for a wave (docs/combat/pending/golive-step1.md; pose-pipeline.md section 9.16), generated by render/anim/tools/wave_gen.mjs: with the wave's live flag on, the listed shapes draw their blows from these lists (walked, every third entry), and the gated key sets join only while their gate is open. Off by default. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-references (every key set named is in the wave's keysets file; a pick list holds key sets of its weight or `any`; a gated key set has the weight the key set has; a shape is in ragdoll_motion.json shapes; a gated key set that is also picked is a warning) are checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js (wave-live-*).

shapes.description: The ragdoll shape keys (ragdoll_motion.json shapes) that use the wave.

light.description: Key sets for a light blow.

heavy.description: Key sets for a heavy blow.

picks.description: The lists a blow is drawn from, by weight.

gated.description: Key sets that join the picks only while their gate is open.

weight.description: The list it joins when its gate is open.

gate.description: both_ground: both fighters on the ground; striker_air: the striker is in the air.
